filtered = df[df['nickname'] == 'blue hose']

# If there is exactly one such row (as expected), check its joined value
if not filtered.empty:
    # Get the joined value for that row
    joined_value = filtered['joined'].iloc[0]
    # Compare to the claimed year "1965"
